rules.advice: Replace {name} with your own store: keep the widths from the afterColumnResize hook and the heights from the afterRowResize hook, and pass them back as an array to manualColumnResize or manualRowResize. 19.0 removes the method, so the call throws a TypeError.
Remove the call: the Alt+Enter shortcut that opens a cell's link is a core grid shortcut now, so it works on every grid. 19.0 deprecates the method and 20.0 removes it.

Replace the call with its argument, or call your own sanitizer. The helper returned its input unchanged since 18.0, and 19.0 removes it, so the call throws a TypeError. A project that came from 17.x relied on the sanitizing the helper did then. To sanitize the HTML the grid renders, set the sanitizer option.
